quarterly_data.signal: Quanta filed July 2026 consolidated net revenue of NT$366,274,080 thousand, up 131.32% from NT$158,342,022 thousand in July 2025; year-to-date revenue was NT$2,212,087,847 thousand, up 92.67% YoY. The filed reason for the change is a change in product mix.
